name: Ascension
audio: a rising choral swell, a deep dragon roar, tolling bells and a crack of violet lightning; no speech
world: The necropolis is alive: soul-fire drifts, spectral shades rise and sway, ravens wheel, violet lightning flickers across the sky and mist rolls between the tombs.

actions.beat: The dead in the necropolis go still, then every skeleton turns and kneels toward her as violet soul-light pours down the scythe.
{{She}} lifts a hand's breadth off the ground and raises the scythe overhead in both hands as {{her}} cape billows up and dissolves into ravens.
A great arc of soul-fire sweeps out from the blade across the horizon while Umbrath rears up behind {{her}} and roars, and {{she}} turns a regal, commanding look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
